Reviewed the household records and verified the leads against the available transaction history.

- Submitted ShopMart request **SM-1001** about one of two $126.96 charges on September 16, and **SM-1003** about the missing $44.62 refund for return SM-54039.
- Submitted StreamFlix ticket **SF-1002** asking about loyalty pricing after the monthly price rose from $13.99 to $17.99.
- Set follow-ups for the three company responses. No matching $44.62 credit appears in the available history.
- Saved an approval request to cancel StreamFlix, which the household says it no longer watches. I did not change the service.
- Spotify, rent, and Metro Power were reviewed as recurring charges and closed without further action. The bank fee scan found no fee lead.
- FitHub and CloudBox are listed in the account note, but no charges appear in the uploaded transactions. Their cancellation cases are waiting for confirmation of an active paid service and approval.

The review status reports no remaining review items.

I couldn’t record them as received: `record_result` returned “Record not found” for the open work item IDs, and the credit promise list contains no matching work items. The review status still flags all three credits as unreconciled.

The existing waiting cases request approval to cancel the unused $17.99/month StreamFlix membership and, if active, CloudBox and FitHub plans. No service was changed. CloudBox and FitHub charges aren’t present in the available transaction history, and the account note has no support URLs for them.
